g.text: • 4 of 10 biomarkers peak within 0-3 d; 7 peak at either edge of the window (0-3 d or 21-30 d).

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 6.8px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: • Cardiovascular markers show the most symmetrical responses with

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 6.8px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: SHAP balanced across positive and negative directions.

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 6.8px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: • Haematological markers (Hct, Hb) peak at lag 1/1 d, consistent with

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 6.8px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: acute haemoconcentration within days of hot weather.

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 6.8px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: • Body-composition markers peak at lag 7/14 d (medium-horizon exposure).

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 6.8px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: • CI ribbons: 50 bootstrap replicates, 95% percentile interval.

text.style: fill: #444444; font: 7.1px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Mean |SHAP| of temperature at each lag (0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 21, 30 d) from interventional TreeSHAP, 50 bootstrap replicates.

text.style: fill: #444444; font: 7.1px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Ribbon = 95% percentile CI. Marker fill encodes directional asymmetry (pct_positive: fraction of patient-visits with SHAP > 0).
